text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, really... Just the thought is more 
than enough for celebrations. I'm beyond 
humbled, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Getting praised by the sparkling main 
character like this... I'm really not used 
to it, you know...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really? But the number of people who want 
to celebrate your birthday has grown by a 
shocking amount, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You always push so hard to stay in a good 
position. To the point where even I can't 
let my guard down.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm not lying. But you know, I was 
thinking, maybe in the future, just 
maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nature might actually end up being the 
Umamusume who gets celebrated the most by 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
From everyone...? No way, impossible. Even 
if it were, it'd take an insane amount of 
time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Who cares if it takes time? Come on, make 
your declaration. Tell me that someday 
you'll catch up to my popularity.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Guh, fine, I got it...! Someday I'll 
definitely catch up to you, Teio! In, in 
three years!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, make that thirty years later!! 
The odds are crazy slim, but I'll do my 
best...!
